g.text: The system can perceive environmental state at all. Sensors, satellites, telemetry, inside the loop.

path.style: fill: #56b4e9; opacity: 0.13; stroke: #56b4e9; stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-linejoin: miter

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #56b4e9

font-size: 7.9px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: An advisory flag. The system says so. Nothing is stopped. This is where the art currently is.

path.style: fill: #56b4e9; opacity: 0.13; stroke: #56b4e9; stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-linejoin: miter

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #56b4e9

font-size: 7.9px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: An auditable record of every environmental deviation, written where the optimiser cannot reach it.

path.style: fill: #e69f00; opacity: 0.13; stroke: #e69f00; stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-linejoin: miter

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #e69f00
font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a
font-size: 7.9px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: An affirmative environmental check is required before the action is allowed to proceed.

path.style: fill: #d55e00; opacity: 0.13; stroke: #d55e00; stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-linejoin: miter

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #d55e00
font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a
font-size: 7.9px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: A trip that fires on physical criteria regardless of the task objective, outside the optimiser's reach.

path.style: fill: #d55e00; opacity: 0.13; stroke: #d55e00; stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-linejoin: miter

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #d55e00

font-size: 7.9px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: The environmental criterion sits in the grading signal itself: non-proxiable, held outside the agent.

g.text: Environmental Safety Mode, stated in the language of process safety.

text.style: font-size: 10.6px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: The entire engineering programme is the distance from L1 to L4.

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: Every plant engineer has watched a safety instrumented system trip a unit over the board operator's objection. That is what L4

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: means, and it is why the line falls where it does: an alarm is a request, an interlock is not. Environmental capability in AI systems

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: today sits at L1 — advisory, overridable, and outranked by the task objective whenever the two disagree. Nothing above the line

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #6e6e6e

g.text: exists yet for environmental criteria in any deployed general-purpose system.
